eṇa: [ i + yu.] (pu)  CL=7 [Dhāna,ṭī.618. Eṇa (saṃ)] A prey is named Eṇī. A goat antelope. A deer. (moga,sya,1.453.moga,sya.2.107). See - Eṇī.
eṇeyya: [ e + ṇeyya.] (ti) CL=7 [Jā,ṭi,saca. Eṇa (eṇī) + ṇeyya. Eṇiyā migiyā, eṇa-ssa vā apaccaṃ eṇeyyo.... Eṇassa, eṇiyā vā dhammādiko eṇeyyo. Dhāna,ṭī.618. Eṇassa vikāro ava-yavo vā eṇeyyaṃ, maṃsaṃ. Moga,sya.2. 107. Eṇissa avayavo eṇeyyaṃ. Nirutti,nhā.331. (saṃ)] (1) An Eṇī prey. A goat (antelope). A black goat (antelope). A part of (the body of) a goat (antelope) (such as a neck). (3) An affliction that is like a goat (antelope).
eṇeyyajaṅgha: [ eṇeyyajaṅghā + jaṅghā ] (ti) CL=7 One whose calves are like the calves of a goat (antelope).
eṇeyyaka: [ eṇa(eṇī) + ṇeyya + ka.] (ti) CL=7 (1) The neck of a goat (antelope). (2) An image of a goat (antelope). Afflicted (by someone) that is like a goat (antelope). (The affliction that the iron rings are put on the two elbow joints and the two knees of (someone) and strike with iron chisels on the ground and then set fire and destroy his body. See - ma,ṭṭha,1.363-4).
eṇeyyakakammakāraṇa: [ eṇeyyaka + kammakāraṇa ] (thī,na) CL=7 The affliction that is like a way of affliction of a goat (antelope). See - Eṇeyyaka.
eṇeyyamiga: [ eṇeyya + miga ] (pu) CL=7 A prey is named Eṇī. See - Eṇeyyamiga.
eṇeyyapasadākiṇṇa: [ eṇeyyapasada + ākiṇṇa ] (ti) CL=7 The place where is crowded with goats (antelopes) and barking deer (muntjac).
eṇi: [ eṇi(ṇī)migajaṅghasadisā + jaṅghā ] (ṇī)migajaṅghasadisajaṅgha (ti) CL=7 One whose calves are like the calves (of the legs) of a goat (antelope). See - Eṇijaṅgha.
eṇieṅghā: [ eṇī + jaṅghā ] (thī) CL=7 Calves of the legs of a goat (antelope). See - Eṇījaṅgha-lakkhaṇa.
eṇijaṅgha: [ eṇī + jaṅghā + jaṅghā.] (ti) CL=7 [Eṇissavīya assa jaṅghāti eṇijaṅgho. Rū,nhā.206. Nīti, sutta,nhā.205.] One whose legs are like the calves of the legs of a goat (antelope). (Lord Buddha whose legs are like the calves of the legs of a goat (antelope) which is a round leg full of flesh cannot see the bone of the leg).
eṇijaṅghalakkhaṇa: [ eṇijaṅghā + jaṅghā + lakkhaṇa ] (na) CL=7 The sign that is the calves of the legs of one which is like the calves of the legs of a goat (antelope). Eṇijaṅghalakkhaṇa.
eṇijaṅghalakkhaṇakathana: [ eṇijaṅghalakkhaṇa + kathana ] (na) CL=7 A phrase that discusses the sign or an auspicious mark of having goat (antelope) calves.
eṇimigabahula: [ eṇimiga + bahula ] (ti) CL=7 There are many goats (antelopes). See - Eṇī(ṇī)kula.
eṇimigabāhulla: [ eṇimiga + bāhulla ] (na) CL=7 As a state of having many goats (antelopes). See - Eṇi-(ṇī)kula.
eṇī: [ i + yu + ī (itthī paccaññaḥ).] (thī,pu) CL=7 [I gatiyaṃ, yu, nadādi. Anadāditte eṇo. Dhāna,ṭī.618. I+ṇa+ī. Vi,pi,dhāna. E+ṇī. See - Eṇeyya. Eṇī (saṃ). Iṇa+ṇī. Jā,ṭī,saca. See - Eṇeyyaka (2)]. (1) A river is named Eṇī. (2) A prey is named Eṇī. A goat (antelope). A female black goat (antelope).
eṇīphassā: [ yādicchakanāma ] (thī) CL=7 A female deva is named Eṇīphassā.
